quote: Figure 2. Application of the House of Quality diagram on the data of the enterprise "JSC "KazanOrgSyntez"
justification: The enterprise is a registered-sector (organic synthesis / petrochemical) producer and the method is demonstrated on its own data, so the sector test passes. It fails the other half of §5.3: what is applied is a QFD/House-of-Quality matrix aligning energy-efficiency strategy goals with corporate strategy goals. No EnPI, no energy baseline, no measured energy quantity — therefore no EnPI/EnB model is applied, validated or empirically demonstrated. A1b=methodological/theoretical, A9='not specified'. Excluded on what the model is, not on the sector.
